title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Planet Hollywood Resort, Las Vegas | 2017
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 28 October 2017.

It was the eighth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s US tour, which lasted for 21 dates in October and November 2017, and the last of eight non-consecutive nights at the Planet Hollywood Resort.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums

  • ‘Hold The Line’ (Steve Lukather)
  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘Give Peace A Chance’
